meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Maximum-saturation research orchestration: parallel explore+librarian swarms across codebase, web, official docs, and OSS repos; a recursive EXPAND loop driven by leads workers return in message text; empirical verification by running code; cited synthesis and optional MD/HTML/PDF/PPTX reports. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research — the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行探索代码库与文档，生成引证研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行深入的技术研究和报告撰写
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate maximum-saturation research across codebase and docs, generating cited reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to conduct deep technical research and synthesize findings

howto.what: 触发后,Claude 进入深度研究模式:并行派出搜索小队查代码库、网页、官方文档和开源仓库;按线索递归深挖到耗尽;有争议处运行代码验证。最终给带引用的综合报告,可存为 MD/HTML/PDF/PPTX。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求研究时触发:说「ulw-research」、带「ulw」的研究措辞,或直接要求做研究/深度研究/精确调查(任意语言)。普通问答、调试、收集上下文时不会自行启动。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 彻底调研一下 Rust 的异步运行时生态。
say.note: Claude 会开启多路并行研究并给出带引用的报告。

say.text: ulw-research:查清这个开源库的许可证争议,我要引用。
say.note: 会派多个搜索方向交叉验证,必要时运行代码核实。

say.text: 做一次深度研究:比较 SQLite 与 DuckDB 在数据分析场景的差异。
say.note: 触发深度研究模式,覆盖文档、代码与实测验证。

howto.what_en: On trigger, Claude enters deep-research mode: parallel explorer/librarian teams comb codebase, web, docs, OSS repos; leads chased recursively; contested claims verified by running code. Output: cited synthesis, as MD/HTML/PDF/PPTX.
howto.when_en: Activates only on explicit research demand: 'ulw-research', 'ulw' wording, or explicit research/deep-research request, any language. Not for ordinary questions, debugging, or context-gathering.

say_en.text: Run ulw-research to thoroughly investigate Rust's async runtime ecosystem.
say_en.note: Claude launches parallel research, returns a cited report.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research on this library's license dispute; I need citations.
say_en.note: Cross-checks via multiple angles; may run code to verify.

say_en.text: Do a deep research on SQLite vs DuckDB for data-analysis workloads.
say_en.note: Deep-research mode: docs, code, empirical checks.
